headline: Paraguay residency requests surpass 50,000 in 2026
summary: Paraguay's migration office announced that residency applications surpassed 50,000 in 2026, exceeding the previous year's record, with Brazilians forming the largest group of applicants.
why: Cross-border migration and residency trends signal demographic shifts, regional labor mobility, and capital inflows into real estate and local businesses.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Rising residency applications indicate increased immigration and domestic economic engagement.
